title: Status and show check every review attempt's relay before showing the claims
description: Status and show check every review attempt's relay before showing the claims
no_spec_change_rationale: Makes the status and show claim projection match REQ-change-relayed-decision-001: reading refuses a damaged relayed_by with its recovery. recorded_claims read only the latest review.json, so a damaged earlier attempt in review-attempts.json was shown as fine.
acceptance_criteria: change status and change show refuse, with the repair-relays recovery, a review-attempts.json attempt whose relay names someone other than its reviewer or is malformed, while the latest review.json is valid; a review with no attempt history still shows its claims (red then green)
